worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.summary: Snap a lightning-straight jolt at the target to paralyse it. It deals no damage; its strength is that it cannot be outrun. Because it travels a line, a wall or an ally standing between you takes the jolt instead. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.descriptio: The jolt reaches targets within %1$s blocks with a collision radius of %2$s; the line must be unobstructed.
On a hit the target is paralysed for %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.surge.on: Long surge: range x1.3 and paralysis x1.2, but +3 windup and cooldown x1.25 - to pin a swift target from afar.
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.surge.off: Quick release: range x0.9 and paralysis x0.9 for a shorter windup and cooldown - to keep up in a close brawl.
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.timing: Needs line of sight: range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.use.0: Pin a swift target in place
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.use.1: Disarm a foe from a safe distance
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.use.2: Let an ally in the line take the jolt instead
worldcombat.skill.thunderwave.preference: On: range x1.3 and paralysis x1.2, but +3 windup and cooldown x1.25, to pin a swift target from afar. Off: quick release, range x0.9 and paralysis x0.9 for a shorter windup and cooldown, to keep up in a close brawl.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of casting. Larger values chase harder and lose the line more often at long range.
When on, a target that is moving fast gets priority 65 so the one charging in is pinned first; when off, all threats rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to discharge; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
